models.title: Shares issuable from bond-linked warrants
models.summary: The example divides aggregate principal by the face amount of a ten-bond lot and multiplies by the number of shares subscribable per lot.

relationship.original_equation: Shares issuable = aggregate eligible principal / face amount per lot × shares per lot
relationship.locator: Note 6, $335 Million Unit Offering, printed pF-32
relationship.translation_notes: Principal divided by lot face is a dimensionless count of lots; multiplying by shares per lot produces a share count.

variables.definition: Theoretical total shares issued on exercise of all eligible warrants
variables.context: Same security, currency, nominal/real basis, timing and period frequency as other quantities in this relationship

assumptions: Principal and lot face value are denominated in the same currency and use face amount, not market value or carrying amount.
The principal comprises complete eligible lots with all relevant warrants exercised at the stated unadjusted or adjusted entitlement.
The declared entitlement and eligible warrants account for any separate trading, expirations and corporate-action adjustments.
limitations: Fractional-share settlement, per-holder rounding, exercise price and cash proceeds are not modeled; actual shares issued depend on contract terms.
The owner solution prints an ambiguous arithmetic expression; the lot face value is 100 currency units times 10 bonds, so it is the entire denominator.
